propositions: Infra exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at gate sites must emit an additive gate_error_v1 sidecar record with verdict=ERROR and error cause/evidence before preserving the gate's pre-existing outcome (INDETERMINATE for plan/code-review, exception propagation for completion).
The new gate_error_v1 schema and build_error_payload builder must never route through reconcile_verdict so the ERROR verdict is not coerced to FAIL.
Existing verdict readers must ignore gate_error_v1 records via schema guards, preventing ERROR records from surfacing in latest_review_result or latest_fail_verdict reads.
Domain BLOCK/FAIL outcomes (non-infra exceptions) must not produce gate_error_v1 records.
The ERROR record must be written on existing event types (REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT) without introducing new event types or replay constraints.
